card.name: Small words in all-caps label text
card.fires_on: Short linking words like THE, THIS, SUCH, IS and HAS in all-capital drug-label text, mostly at the start of a new sentence after a period.

modes.label: Sentence-opening THE/THIS
modes.description: The word THE or THIS starts a new sentence in an all-caps warning or precaution.
modes.example: ulants: CAUTION SHOULD BE EXERCISED WHEN WARFARIN IS GIVEN IN CONJUNCTION WITH GEMFIBROZIL.<< THE>> DOSAGE OF WARFARIN SHOULD

modes.label: Linking word mid-sentence
modes.description: A word such as SUCH, IS or HAS follows a noun phrase in capitals.
modes.example: GMOLOGY, SURGERY, THERAPY, UROLOGY, ZOOLOGY, AND THE PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES<< SUCH>> AS PHARMACY AND PHARMAC
